dataset.name: Traditional-first common-word corpus pronunciations
dataset.grain: one record per selected MOE-1996 frequency-row ID
dataset.intended_use: Taiwan-oriented word-level Pinyin and Zhuyin with exact, inspectable source provenance

method.no_match_policy: Retain earlier readings as provisional and record two explicit Taiwan-verification gaps; never infer a fuzzy or converted match.
checks: source workbook SHA-256 and byte length

sources.full_name: Taiwan Ministry of Education Concised Mandarin Dictionary
Taiwan Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Dictionary

findings.finding: 11,891 of 13,368 word records (88.95%) reproduce an exact prioritized Taiwan-MOE entry.
findings.impact: These records are safe to use as Taiwan-oriented lexical pronunciation data under the stated exact-headword policy.

findings.finding: 1,477 records (11.05%) are absent from both pinned official downloads.
findings.impact: Their current CC-CEDICT/CNS readings must not be represented as Taiwan-MOE-verified.
findings.remediation: Cross-check the queue against another Taiwanese lexical authority or perform documented entry-level review.
